items.source: Resolve the conflict by updating the given columns of the existing row.
items.translation: 通过更新现有行的给定columns来解决冲突。

items.source: Resolve the conflict by updating the existing row using the previously specified assignments for non-conflicting columns that are not part of UpsertBuilder.ConflictColumn.with(Column).
items.translation: 通过更新现有行来解决冲突，使用先前指定的、不属于UpsertBuilder.ConflictColumn.with(Column)的非冲突列的赋值。

items.source: Declare how to resolve a conflict if the row already exists.
items.translation: 声明在行已存在时如何解决冲突。
